titleJa: 木造ファサード・格子戸
artStyle: Japanese Woodblock / Sumi-Ink / Warm Washi Paper Watercolor

groundFloor.title: Ground Floor: Timber Doors & Shop Window
groundFloor.features: Taisho-era sliding timber lattice doors (格子戸), warm golden threshold interior glow, 9-pane wooden shop display window with ceramics and rice sacks, striped awning, foundation planters

secondFloor.title: Second Floor: 3 Window Bays & Stucco
secondFloor.features: 3 timber sash window bays (18 sky-reflecting glass panes), warm buff plaster mortar stucco wall with hairline texture, white wall AC unit, yakisugi cedar fascia board

roof.title: Pitched Kawara Ceramic Tile Roof Prism
roof.geometry: Solid closed prism with top ceramic tiles (22 deg pitch), underside soffit ceiling, gable pediments, and 16 exposed timber rafter tails

awning.title: Cantilevered Striped Canvas Sun Awning
awning.geometry: Solid double-sided volume with hunter green & cream scalloped canvas and fabric underside
